mechanism_narrative: The persistent collapse in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates fewer routine trips into activity centers, so discretionary shopping demand remains suppressed and RETAIL_REC stays lower over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +30 while WORKPLACES remains below -70, time at home substitutes for shopping trips, so retail visits fall again within two weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 31.1 at t-0w while WORKPLACES is -76.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL remains above 30 and WORKPLACES remains below -70 for at least one weekly observation.
